purpose: Reusable, immutable session-event runner for 60-completed-session futures momentum with conservative lagged CFTC TFF context. Adds a predeclared 20-session volatility-scaled TSM versus same-interval passive-long comparison, with Python row-level parity.

retrospective_window.interpretation: 2022-2025 historical years plus 2026 YTD; this is a previously explored sample, not a clean holdout.

input_contract.timezone: UTC instants; Topstep CME trade-date session labels from immutable Arrow export
known_data_quality_notes: MNQ 2026-08-31 continuous-series seam remains a quarantined source-quality sensitivity.
MES has two known missing minutes in shortened 2023 holiday RTH sessions.
2026 is YTD; MNQ snapshot ends 2026-09-23 and MES snapshot ends 2026-09-14.

frozen_protocol.TFF_feature: sign((Leveraged Funds long - short) / total open interest)
frozen_protocol.CFTC_availability: report as-of date + 7 calendar days at 15:30 America/New_York; first session open strictly after availability
frozen_protocol.candidate: take the 60-session close-to-close trend only when lagged TFF sign agrees
frozen_protocol.baseline: same 60-session trend without the TFF alignment filter
frozen_protocol.execution: fixed-size reference uses one contract; sized variants use sequential non-overlapping intervals, entry at eligible session open, exit at next eligible report-event session open

volatility_scaling.estimator: population standard deviation of simple returns, annualized by sqrt(252)
volatility_scaling.size: round half up target / realized volatility; clip to 1-3 micro contracts
volatility_scaling.passive_long_pair: same report intervals, realized-vol size, entry/exit, costs and 14-tick stress

research_gates_pending: candidate must pass shared walk-forward and Monte Carlo gates in net and 14-tick stress
date-cluster net/stress uncertainty, best-entry-day removal, annual slices, and at least 12-month coverage must support durability
versioned Topstep MLL account-path simulation with intraday unrealized P&L
volatility-scaled trend candidate must show a durable advantage over its same-event passive-long pair
minimum 12-month prospective shadow tracking after the rule freeze
